name: Ember Fan (Tàn Hỏa Phiến)

arts.name: Fanning Embers (Quạt Tàn Hỏa)
arts.rule: One sweep of burning wind: a quick Fire hit that lays 2 Burn stacks for 6 s.

lore: A paper fan painted with coals. Refiners in Fire sects make them for their outer disciples.
build_use: The Bonfire's first weapon: a cheap, quick Burn source before its công pháp arts arrive.

name: Cinder Ring (Hỏa Tẫn Giới)
lore: A plain iron band with a coal sealed in its bezel. It is always warm.
build_use: Any Fire build's early ring: Burn damage, a stronger Fire buff, a little health.

name: Furnace-Mouth Gourd (Lô Khẩu Hồ Lô)

arts.name: Gourd Swallows the Flame (Hồ Lô Thôn Diễm)
arts.rule: The gourd drinks the flames on the foe: a Fire hit. With 10 Burn stacks or more on the foe, it swallows 5 of them and spits them back as a hit 2.2 times as hard.

lore: Alchemists keep their best pills in gourds like this one; its mouth was widened to swallow furnace fire.
build_use: The Furnace Master and The Bonfire: turns a Burn pile into one heavy hit, and Kindled Wound makes every Fire part hit harder on a burning foe.

name: Smouldering Robe (Âm Hỏa Đạo Bào)

wards.name: Smouldering Veil (Âm Hỏa Sa)
wards.notes: The starter veil at 0.8 of its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged (4.545 of 4.575)

lore: A robe woven with fire-rat hair. It smoulders and never catches.
build_use: A Fire caster's armour against Fire foes and Fire sects; light, so it leaves thần thức for treasures.

name: Hearth-Keeper Pendant (Thủ Lô Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Hearth Aura (Lô Hỏa Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Burn batches last 25 % longer and your Fire debuff stacks are 10 % stronger.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 12 % reserved buys up to 12 W

lore: Red jade carved as a closed furnace. Hearth-keepers of Fire sects wear it on duty.
build_use: The Bonfire and The Phoenix Feather: a standing Burn upgrade paid in linh lực, not in an art slot.

name: Red Sun Seal (Hồng Nhật Ấn)

arts.name: Red Sun Descends (Hồng Nhật Giáng)
arts.rule: Counts as a Red Sun Scripture art. A slow Fire seal that lays 4 Burn stacks for 6 s. In Brazier Form, or with 6 Heat, it falls twice as hard.

lore: A vermilion seal cast in the Red Sun lineage's forges, so their scripture's arts answer to it.
build_use: Red Sun Scripture builds: a fourth suite art that the suite's engines count (Twin Flame, Furnace Heart, Flint Volley), without learning another technique.

name: Phoenix Plume Armour (Phượng Vũ Giáp)

effects.name: Phoenix Mend (Phượng Dũ)
effects.rule: When you restore health with an art, the enemy gains 1 Burn stack for each 1 % of your maximum health restored, at most 6 a pulse, at your Burn's values.
effects.reads: Health restored by your arts, live
effects.payload: Fire debuff stacks on the enemy
effects.from: single-fire.md, The Phoenix Feather (its New piece, as an Effect instead of an art)
effects.status: accepted for now (user, 2026-11-12); not yet in effects.md

wards.name: Phoenix Shell (Phượng Xác)
wards.notes: The starter shield at 1.5 times its shield and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (3.750 of 3.813)

lore: Scale armour set with phoenix plumes; it warms when its wearer heals.
build_use: The Phoenix Feather: every heal also burns the foe, so the healer-striker's mending is its damage.

name: Ring of Blood Kindling (Huyết Dẫn Giới)
lore: A ring of blood-red iron from a demonic-path forge. It drinks from the finger that wears it.
build_use: The Self-Immolator: Blood Casting lets arts run on health once linh lực is gone; the leech and health keep the fury going.
notes: Spends 78 %: Blood Casting is a strong enabler

name: Ashen Phoenix Fan (Tro Phượng Phiến)

effects.name: Fan the Pyre (Phiến Hỏa Liệu Nguyên)
effects.rule: Each Fire hit you land refreshes the duration of every Burn batch you have on the target.
effects.payload: Burn batches on the target restart their timers
effects.closes: Your direct Fire hits deal 15 % less.
effects.status: accepted for now (user, 2026-11-12); not yet in effects.md

arts.name: Ash-Feather Gale (Tro Vũ Cuồng Phong)
arts.rule: Counts as an Ashen Phoenix Canon art. A Fire gale that lays 3 Burn stacks for 6 s. Every Burn tick you deal blows a Cinder into the fan (twice a pulse at most). With 4 Cinders, and either 40 % of your health gone or another Ashen Phoenix art fired in the last 3 s, the fan unleashes the Ash-Feather Gale: four times as hard, spending the Cinders.

holder: An elder of a Fire sect at Core Formation or above; otherwise Lost in a burned-out secret realm
lore: Woven from the tail feathers of a phoenix that burned itself out. The Ashen Phoenix lineage lost it three generations ago.
build_use: The Bonfire's keystone piece: Burn never runs out while the hits keep coming, and with the Ashen Phoenix Canon the fan becomes the suite's finisher.

name: Undying Ember Lantern (Bất Diệt Tàn Đăng)

effects.name: Embers Never Die (Tàn Hỏa Bất Diệt)
effects.rule: Your Burn on a target cannot be cleansed. A cleanse that would remove it removes the same number of your own Fire buff stacks instead.
effects.closes: Your own wards cannot cleanse you.
effects.from: new (answers the cleansing wards listed as The Bonfire's weakness)
effects.status: accepted for now (user, 2026-11-12); not yet in effects.md

reserve_arts.name: Lantern of the Long Burn (Trường Diễm Đăng Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, the first Burn batch you lay in a fight never expires.
reserve_arts.notes: Grants a rule, no modifiers, so nothing to price under Formulas I

holder: A Nascent Soul Fire cultivator, or the final reward of a Legendary quest in a Fire sect's ruins
lore: Its wick is a sliver of a sun-crow's bone. It has not gone out in four thousand years.
build_use: Burn builds against cleansing foes (Clear Heart Ward, cleansing curses): the Burn stays, and one batch burns all fight.
